notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.1
notes.content:
Hi everyone! Thanks for all the love you've shown towards [b]Dungeon Board[/b]! Just a few quick fixes coming through to help keep things as smooth as possible!

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Disabled Developer Mode (oops!)
[*] Fixed UI dropdowns not scrolling properly with the mouse wheel.
[*] Added an option to configure your camera zoom speed.
[/list]

Thanks again for all the support! See you again soon!
